# 1. 분석 대상

이 보고서는 `Fungi_k`와 `Ascomycota_p`로만 분류된 Cutadapt ASV를 대상으로 함. 각 Cutadapt ASV 내부에서 exact match되는 ITSxpress ASV를 찾아 다음처럼 직접 표시함.

```text
Cutadapt   [left external sequence][exact ITSxpress sequence][right external sequence]
ITSxpress  -------------------------[exact ITSxpress sequence]-------------------------
Match                               |||||||||||||||||||||||||||
```

여기서 주황색 구간은 두 방법에서 염기가 완전히 동일한 부분이며, 회색 dash는 ITSxpress 결과에 존재하지 않는 Cutadapt 외부 서열임.

```{r input}
asv_metrics <- read_csv(
  "Results/01_Preprocessing/05a_unresolved_taxa_ASV_metrics.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
all_matches <- read_csv(
  "Results/01_Preprocessing/05m_all_exact_containment_pairs.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

sequence_info <- asv_metrics |>
  select(Method, FeatureID, Sequence, Raw_Taxonomy)

cut_info <- sequence_info |>
  filter(Method == "Cutadapt") |>
  transmute(
    Cutadapt_FeatureID = FeatureID,
    Cutadapt_Sequence = Sequence,
    Cutadapt_Raw_Taxonomy = Raw_Taxonomy
  )

its_info <- sequence_info |>
  filter(Method == "ITSxpress") |>
  transmute(
    ITSxpress_FeatureID = FeatureID,
    ITSxpress_Sequence = Sequence,
    ITSxpress_Raw_Taxonomy = Raw_Taxonomy
  )

focus_pairs <- all_matches |>
  filter(
    Cutadapt_Group %in% c("Fungi_k", "Ascomycota_p"),
    Match_Type == "ITSxpress_within_Cutadapt"
  ) |>
  left_join(cut_info, by = "Cutadapt_FeatureID") |>
  left_join(its_info, by = "ITSxpress_FeatureID") |>
  mutate(
    ITS_Start = str_locate(Cutadapt_Sequence, fixed(ITSxpress_Sequence))[, "start"],
    ITS_End = ITS_Start + ITSxpress_Length - 1L,
    Left_Flank_bp = ITS_Start - 1L,
    Right_Flank_bp = Cutadapt_Length - ITS_End,
    Total_Flank_bp = Left_Flank_bp + Right_Flank_bp
  ) |>
  arrange(factor(Cutadapt_Group, levels = c("Fungi_k", "Ascomycota_p")),
          desc(Cutadapt_Total_Reads)) |>
  group_by(Cutadapt_Group) |>
  mutate(Group_Pair = row_number()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(Pair_ID = if_else(
    Cutadapt_Group == "Fungi_k",
    sprintf("F%02d", Group_Pair),
    sprintf("A%02d", Group_Pair)
  ))

stopifnot(nrow(focus_pairs) == 28L, all(!is.na(focus_pairs$ITS_Start)))
write_csv(focus_pairs, file.path(results_dir, "01_focused_exact_containment_pairs.csv"))
```

# 2. Flank/core 길이 구조

```{r structure-summary}
structure_summary <- focus_pairs |>
  group_by(Cutadapt_Group) |>
  summarise(
    N_ASV_pairs = n(),
    Median_Cutadapt_length = median(Cutadapt_Length),
    Median_ITSxpress_length = median(ITSxpress_Length),
    Median_left_flank = median(Left_Flank_bp),
    Median_right_flank = median(Right_Flank_bp),
    Median_total_flank = median(Total_Flank_bp),
    Min_total_flank = min(Total_Flank_bp),
    Max_total_flank = max(Total_Flank_bp),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

datatable_basic(structure_summary, 10)
write_csv(structure_summary, file.path(results_dir, "02_flank_core_length_summary.csv"))
```

    Right_flank = Right_Flank_bp
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(c(Left_flank, Exact_ITSxpress_core, Right_flank),

  mutate(
    Region = factor(Region,

# 3. 실제 염기서열 pairwise alignment

각 pair를 75 bp 단위로 나누어 표시함. 아래에는 ASV 이름보다 실제 A/C/G/T 배열이 중심이 되도록 구성함.

```{r pairwise-functions, include=FALSE}
escape_html <- function(x) htmltools::htmlEscape(x)

style_cut_window <- function(seq, from, to, core_start, core_end) {
  pos <- seq.int(from, to)
  chars <- substring(seq, pos, pos)
  cls <- ifelse(pos >= core_start & pos <= core_end, "seq-core", "seq-flank")
  runs <- rle(cls)
  ends <- cumsum(runs$lengths)
  starts <- c(1, head(ends, -1) + 1)
  paste0(vapply(seq_along(starts), function(i) {
    paste0("<span class='", runs$values[i], "'>",
           paste0(chars[starts[i]:ends[i]], collapse = ""), "</span>")
  }, character(1)), collapse = "")
}

style_its_window <- function(its, full_length, core_start, core_end, from, to) {
  pos <- seq.int(from, to)
  chars <- vapply(pos, function(p) {
    if (p < core_start || p > core_end) "-" else substring(its, p - core_start + 1L, p - core_start + 1L)
  }, character(1))
  cls <- ifelse(chars == "-", "seq-gap", "seq-core")
  runs <- rle(cls)
  ends <- cumsum(runs$lengths)
  starts <- c(1, head(ends, -1) + 1)
  paste0(vapply(seq_along(starts), function(i) {
    paste0("<span class='", runs$values[i], "'>",
           paste0(chars[starts[i]:ends[i]], collapse = ""), "</span>")
  }, character(1)), collapse = "")
}

render_pair <- function(row, width = 75L) {
  n <- nchar(row$Cutadapt_Sequence)
  starts <- seq.int(1L, n, by = width)
  blocks <- vapply(starts, function(from) {
    to <- min(from + width - 1L, n)
    cut_html <- style_cut_window(row$Cutadapt_Sequence, from, to,
                                 row$ITS_Start, row$ITS_End)
    its_html <- style_its_window(row$ITSxpress_Sequence, n,
                                 row$ITS_Start, row$ITS_End, from, to)
    match_chars <- ifelse(seq.int(from, to) >= row$ITS_Start &
                            seq.int(from, to) <= row$ITS_End, "|", " ")
    match_html <- paste0("<span class='seq-match'>",
                         paste0(match_chars, collapse = ""), "</span>")
    paste0(
      sprintf("%7d-%-7d\n", from, to),
      "Cutadapt   ", cut_html, "\n",
      "ITSxpress  ", its_html, "\n",
      "Match      ", match_html, "\n"
    )
  }, character(1))

  card_class <- ifelse(row$Cutadapt_Group == "Fungi_k", "seq-card fungi", "seq-card")
  paste0(
    "<div class='", card_class, "'>",
    "<div class='seq-meta'><b>", row$Pair_ID, " · ", row$Cutadapt_Group,
    "</b> &nbsp; Cutadapt ", row$Cutadapt_Length, " bp · ITSxpress ",
    row$ITSxpress_Length, " bp · left/right flank ", row$Left_Flank_bp,
    "/", row$Right_Flank_bp, " bp · Cutadapt reads ",
    scales::comma(row$Cutadapt_Total_Reads), "</div>",
    "<pre class='seq-block'>", paste0(blocks, collapse = "\n"), "</pre></div>"
  )
}

plain_pair <- function(row, width = 75L) {
  n <- nchar(row$Cutadapt_Sequence)
  aligned_its <- paste0(
    strrep("-", row$ITS_Start - 1L), row$ITSxpress_Sequence,
    strrep("-", n - row$ITS_End)
  )
  starts <- seq.int(1L, n, by = width)
  blocks <- vapply(starts, function(from) {
    to <- min(from + width - 1L, n)
    cut <- substring(row$Cutadapt_Sequence, from, to)
    its <- substring(aligned_its, from, to)
    mat <- ifelse(strsplit(its, "")[[1]] == "-", " ", "|")
    paste0(sprintf("%d-%d\n", from, to),
           "Cutadapt  ", cut, "\n",
           "ITSxpress ", its, "\n",
           "Match     ", paste0(mat, collapse = ""), "\n")
  }, character(1))
  paste0(">", row$Pair_ID, " | ", row$Cutadapt_Group,
         " | left/core/right=", row$Left_Flank_bp, "/",
         row$ITSxpress_Length, "/", row$Right_Flank_bp, " bp\n",
         paste0(blocks, collapse = "\n"))
}
```

# 4. 그룹별 multiple sequence alignment

각 pair의 Cutadapt와 ITSxpress 서열을 함께 DECIPHER로 정렬함. `CUT`와 `ITS`가 같은 pair 번호를 공유함. 아래 화면은 실제 정렬 서열을 70 column씩 나눈 것이며, 전체 FASTA도 별도로 저장함.

```{r msa-functions, include=FALSE}
make_group_alignment <- function(dat, group_name) {
  seqs <- unlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(dat)), function(i) {
    setNames(
      c(dat$Cutadapt_Sequence[i], dat$ITSxpress_Sequence[i]),
      c(paste0(dat$Pair_ID[i], "_CUT_", substr(dat$Cutadapt_FeatureID[i], 1, 8)),
        paste0(dat$Pair_ID[i], "_ITS_", substr(dat$ITSxpress_FeatureID[i], 1, 8)))
    )
  }))
  dna <- DNAStringSet(seqs)
  aln <- AlignSeqs(dna, processors = 1, verbose = FALSE)
  writeXStringSet(
    aln,
    file.path(results_dir, paste0("06_", group_name, "_Cutadapt_ITSxpress_MSA.fasta"))
  )
  aln
}

color_msa <- function(x) {
  chars <- strsplit(x, "", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  cls <- c(A = "msa-a", C = "msa-c", G = "msa-g", T = "msa-t", `-` = "msa-gap")
  paste0(vapply(chars, function(ch) {
    paste0("<span class='", unname(cls[ch]), "'>", ch, "</span>")
  }, character(1)), collapse = "")
}

render_msa <- function(aln, width = 70L) {
  mat <- as.matrix(aln)
  seq_strings <- apply(mat, 1, paste0, collapse = "")
  aln_width <- ncol(mat)
  label_width <- max(nchar(names(seq_strings)))
  starts <- seq.int(1L, aln_width, by = width)
  blocks <- vapply(starts, function(from) {
    to <- min(from + width - 1L, aln_width)
    rows <- vapply(seq_along(seq_strings), function(i) {
      paste0(sprintf(paste0("%-", label_width, "s  "), names(seq_strings)[i]),
             color_msa(substring(seq_strings[i], from, to)))
    }, character(1))
    paste0(sprintf("Alignment columns %d-%d\n", from, to),
           paste0(rows, collapse = "\n"))
  }, character(1))
  paste0("<pre class='msa-block'>", paste0(blocks, collapse = "\n\n"), "</pre>")
}

fungi_msa <- make_group_alignment(fungi_rows, "Fungi_k")
asco_msa <- make_group_alignment(asco_rows, "Ascomycota_p")
```

## 4.1 Fungi_k Cutadapt + ITSxpress MSA

```{r fungi-msa-view, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat(render_msa(fungi_msa, 70L))
```

## 4.2 Ascomycota_p Cutadapt + ITSxpress MSA

```{r asco-msa-view, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
cat("<details><summary>Ascomycota_p 40-sequence MSA 펼치기</summary>")
cat(render_msa(asco_msa, 70L))
cat("</details>")
```

# 5. 관찰 결과

```{r conclusion, results='asis'}
fungi_summary <- structure_summary |> filter(Cutadapt_Group == "Fungi_k")
asco_summary <- structure_summary |> filter(Cutadapt_Group == "Ascomycota_p")

cat(paste0(
  "- `Fungi_k` exact-containment pair는 ", nrow(fungi_rows), "개이며 median left/core/right 길이는 ",
  fungi_summary$Median_left_flank, "/", fungi_summary$Median_ITSxpress_length, "/",
  fungi_summary$Median_right_flank, " bp임.\n",
  "- `Ascomycota_p` exact-containment pair는 ", nrow(asco_rows), "개이며 median left/core/right 길이는 ",
  asco_summary$Median_left_flank, "/", asco_summary$Median_ITSxpress_length, "/",
  asco_summary$Median_right_flank, " bp임.\n",
  "- 두 그룹 모두 ITSxpress 서열은 Cutadapt ASV 중앙의 완전 동일 구간이며, 차이는 주로 Cutadapt에 남은 양쪽 외부 서열에서 발생함.\n",
  "- 따라서 이 두 미해결 taxonomy 그룹에서는 단순한 서로 다른 ASV라기보다, 같은 내부 ITS 서열을 서로 다른 boundary로 표현한 경우가 실제 염기서열에서 확인됨.\n",
  "- 다만 이 구조만으로 ITSxpress taxonomy가 항상 더 정확하다고 단정할 수는 없으며, reference database match와 raw read boundary를 함께 확인해야 함."
))
```
